title: Consistent Rest & Recovery
hook: Rest isn't the reward for finishing. Nothing in a business is ever finished.
statement: Schedule recovery like you schedule work. It's part of the job, not a bonus.
explainer: If recovery doesn't keep pace with stress, performance slides no matter how hard you push. Rest that only happens after you crash isn't a system.
sop: Honestly score your Stress and Recovery from 1 to 10.
Put recovery blocks on your calendar like client meetings.
Pick one hard boundary, like no email after hours, and hold it.
Don't let sleep or your day off be the first thing cut.
Check monthly whether the two are drifting apart.
equation_example: Stress 8, Recovery 3. 3 ÷ 8 = 0.38, so recovery isn't keeping up. Bump Recovery to 7: 7 ÷ 8 = 0.88, and performance holds. Higher means you can sustain it. Lower means you're borrowing against tomorrow.
question: Write down one recovery block you'll put on your calendar this week and protect.
closing_statement: Unscheduled rest is always the first thing cut.
caption:
Principle Nº 217: Consistent Rest & Recovery

Rest isn't the reward for finishing. Nothing in a business is ever finished.

Schedule recovery like you schedule work. It's part of the job, not a bonus.

Your turn: Write down one recovery block you'll put on your calendar this week and protect.
